Professional Summary

ReactJS, TypeScript, Next.js, Redux, Jest, CSS, Webpack, Git, Linux

- Optimized bundle sizes through Webpack configuration tweaks and code-splitting in TypeScript projects, lowering initial page load by measurable percentages on Linux-hosted staging environments.

UI Engineer, Zoho (May 2021 - Jun 2023)

- Collaborated on state management strategies using Redux and streamlined developer workflows with Webpack and Git-based CI processes.
